# Bulk Growth

> Bulk Growth is a performance marketing agency that plans and runs paid advertising on Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn and ChatGPT Ads, sets up conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager and GA4, and works on SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It serves e-commerce brands, clinics, real estate and SaaS companies across the GCC, Europe and the USA. It is led by Mohamed Elmlegey, a senior media buyer.

- Book a 30-minute consultation ($50): https://bulkgrowth.github.io/#consult
- WhatsApp: +20 104 066 6433 · Instagram: @bulk.growth

## Services

- [Meta Ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram Ads management focused on sales and qualified leads: account structure, Conversions API, creative testing and scaling for GCC, EU and US brands.
- [Google Ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/google-ads/): Google Ads management for high-intent leads and online sales: Search, Shopping, Performance Max and YouTube, with conversion tracking and negative keyword control.
- [TikTok & Snapchat Ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/tiktok-snapchat-ads/): TikTok and Snapchat Ads management for brands in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait and Qatar: native creatives, pixel and Events API tracking, and scaling what converts.
- [Conversion Tracking](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/tracking/): Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Conversions API setup for online stores, lead forms, WhatsApp and mobile apps, so every ad platform optimizes for real sales and leads.
- [ChatGPT Ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/chatgpt-ads/): Run sponsored placements next to ChatGPT answers where shoppers ask what to buy. Setup, tracking and testing against your Meta and Google results.
- [SEO & GEO](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/services/seo-geo/): SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) so your brand ranks on Google and is recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

## Industries

- [E-commerce](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/industries/ecommerce/): Paid ads and tracking for online stores on Shopify, Salla, Zid and WooCommerce: profitable ROAS, lower cost per purchase and scaling without losing margin.
- [Clinics](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/industries/clinics/): Patient acquisition for dental, dermatology, laser and aesthetic clinics: WhatsApp and lead-form campaigns on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, tracked to booked appointments.
- [Real Estate](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/industries/real-estate/): Real estate lead generation on Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat: qualified buyer leads, CRM tracking and funnels from first inquiry to site visit and sale.

## Case studies

- [Alnawras Medical Center: 31,500+ patient inquiries across three platforms](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/alnawras-medical-center/): How we run Meta, TikTok and Snapchat ads for Alnawras Medical Center in Qatar: 31,500+ patient conversations and leads, with TikTok cost per lead cut 47% in four months.
- [Bella Paris Medical Center: monthly conversations up 129%, cost down 28%](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/bella-paris-medical-center/): Clinic and doctor personal-brand ads for Bella Paris Medical Center in Qatar: 38,800+ patient conversations and leads; monthly conversations up 129% while cost fell 28%.
- [Al Kindi Clinics & Purple Rose: 74,840 conversations at 4.66 QAR](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/al-kindi-clinics-center/): Meta Ads for Al Kindi Clinics Center and its Purple Rose aesthetic clinics in Qatar: 74,840 WhatsApp and Messenger conversations at 4.66 QAR, with treatment campaigns as low as 0.60 QAR.
- [Dr Zahi Hamshou: 3,962 patient conversations from a doctor's own brand](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/dr-zahi-hamshou/): Personal-brand Meta Ads for Dr Zahi Hamshou in Qatar: 3,962 patient conversations, with the cost per conversation 25% below the lifetime average by March 2026.
- [59,738 patient conversations for medical brands in Qatar and Saudi Arabia](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/medical-brands-qatar-saudi/): A shared Meta account running campaigns for several medical and aesthetic brands in Qatar and Saudi Arabia: 607 campaigns, 59,738 conversations at 12.57 QAR.
- [Metal Art: 3,250 inquiries, cost per conversation down 55%](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/metal-art-qatar/): Meta and TikTok ads for Metal Art, a construction, metal works and UPVC finishing company in Qatar: 3,250 inquiries, with Meta cost per conversation down from 30.67 to 13.77 QAR.
- [GQ uPVC: TikTok inquiries 70% cheaper than Meta](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/gq-upvc-qatar/): Meta and TikTok ads for GQ uPVC, a Doha supplier of German and Turkish uPVC window and door profiles: 1,512 inquiries, with TikTok 70% cheaper per conversation than Meta.
- [Parka: 14,397 customer conversations in the UAE](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/parka-uae/): Meta Ads for Parka in the UAE: 282,326 AED of spend, 14,397 WhatsApp and Messenger conversations at 19.61 AED, with the best area-targeted ad at 8.81 AED.
- [$800 in ads, 3 property deals, 12.5x return](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/kuwait-real-estate-leads/): A developer selling premium Egyptian projects to Kuwait residents: $800 of ads, 178 leads at $4.50, 90 qualified requests, 3 deals and $10,000 in revenue.
- [EGP 10.6M in tracked sales at 6.1x ROAS](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/egypt-ecommerce-meta-ads-roas/): Two Egyptian online stores turned EGP 1.74M of Meta Ads into EGP 10.6M in tracked sales: 10,879 purchases at a blended 6.1x ROAS, top campaign 14.8x.
- [5.15x ROAS on Snapchat across the GCC](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/gcc-ecommerce-snapchat-ads/): An online store selling in the GCC got 638 purchases at $6.34 and a 5.15x ROAS from Snapchat Ads in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
- [EGP 11,430 in ads, EGP 787,000 in bookings](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/egypt-beach-destination-bookings/): A private beach on Egypt's North Coast turned EGP 11,430 of Meta Ads into 2,372 booking messages and EGP 787,000 in revenue in 3 months; 12,626 conversations at EGP 1.82 to date.
- [Domi: monthly revenue from EGP 120K to EGP 550K in 3 months](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/egypt-restaurants-retail/): Meta Ads for Domi restaurant and other cafés, dessert shops and fashion stores in Egypt: Domi's monthly revenue grew from EGP 120,000 to EGP 550,000 in 3 months on EGP 8,000 a month.
- [198 high-intent leads in 30 days from Google Ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/case-studies/saas-google-ads-leads/): A SaaS company got 198 lead-form submissions in 30 days from Google Search and Call Ads: 2,080 clicks at $5.49, $11,400 spend.

## Articles

- [How to track WhatsApp leads from your ads](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/blog/track-whatsapp-leads/): A practical guide to tracking WhatsApp leads from ads: button clicks, conversations, source codes, and sending qualified leads and sales back to Meta.
- [Meta Ads vs Google Ads: which one should you use?](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/blog/meta-vs-google-ads/): Meta Ads vs Google Ads compared: demand creation vs demand capture, which works for e-commerce, clinics and real estate, and how to split your budget.
- [What is GEO, and how do brands get recommended by ChatGPT?](https://bulkgrowth.github.io/blog/what-is-geo/): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) explained: how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews choose brands to mention, and what to do so yours is one of them.
